entries.title: Framework-templated gas lattices in metal-organic frameworks
key_findings: Computational framework combines large-scale MOF screening with ML-guided inverse design
Co-CAU-36 stabilizes xenon in a body-centered cubic (BCC) lattice without extreme bulk pressures
Xe/Kr separation shows preferential ordered-shell occupancy by xenon, displacing krypton to pore core
Inverse design using genetic algorithm successfully targets BCC- and FCC-like gas lattices
entries.implications: Shifts gas storage paradigm from capacity-focused adsorption to molecular-arrangement engineering. Direct relevance to carbon capture, hydrogen storage, and selective catalysis.
entries.c9_relevance: Demonstrates physics-constrained search templates (analogous to C9 MATSCI-004) extended to gas-phase crystallization under confinement.

entries.title: Visualization of the Zhang-Rice singlet, electronic molecules and Cooper pair formation in a cuprate superconductor
entries.institution: Tsinghua University / Chinese Academy of Sciences
key_findings: First direct real-space visualization of localized Zhang-Rice singlet in hole-doped CCOC
Isolated singlets spontaneously merge into 'electronic molecules' (~4 lattice constant plaquettes) with stripe-like orbitals
Electronic molecules connect with increasing hole density, evolving into high-Tc superconducting state
Establishes missing experimental link between microscopic doped-hole physics and macroscopic superconductivity
entries.implications: Provides experimental foundation for unified microscopic framework of cuprate phenomenology. Could guide design of new high-temperature superconductors.
entries.c9_relevance: Directly addresses Cluster 1 (quantum foundations of strongly correlated systems) and Cluster 3 (quantum information/complexity in many-body systems).

entries.title: GDF15 suppresses liver inflammation independently of weight loss through neuroendocrine glucocorticoid signaling
key_findings: GDF15 activates brain-to-liver signaling pathway releasing glucocorticoids
Anti-inflammatory and anti-fibrotic effects occur independently of food intake, body weight, or liver fat
Reprograms liver immune cells into protective, less active state
Complements existing weight-loss therapies for MASH by targeting inflammation directly
entries.implications: Identifies endogenous defense pathway against chronic liver injury. Potential for combination therapies addressing persistent inflammation post-weight loss.
entries.c9_relevance: Cross-domain pattern: structured suppression of dominant pathological mode (inflammation) via hierarchical signaling (brain -> liver).

entries.title: BlackTHUNDER: Evidence of three massive black holes in a z ~ 5 galaxy
entries.institution: Max Planck Institute for Extraterrestrial Physics
key_findings: Three actively accreting SMBHs identified in galaxy J0148-4214 at z = 5.02 (1.2 Gyr post-Big Bang)
Central pair separated by only ~620 light-years; third at ~5,500 light-years
Black hole masses: ~80M, ~0.6M, and ~2M solar masses
Smallest central BH accreting above Eddington limit; central pair expected to merge within few hundred Myr
entries.implications: Supports black-hole merging as fast growth route in early universe. ~38% LISA detectability estimated for central pair merger. Triple systems may be more common than simulations predicted.
entries.c9_relevance: Validates QPLS-related Cluster 16 (SMBH binary dynamics) and extends it to triple systems. High A_c candidate: non-random triple correlation in early cosmic structure.

entries.title: NASA Dragonfly flight fuselage integration begins for Titan exploration
key_findings: Nearly 4-meter flight fuselage delivered; mechanical/thermal/electrical integration underway
MMRTG + battery hybrid power system for sustained rotorcraft operations
Titan's 4.5x Earth atmospheric density and 1/7 Earth gravity yield ~40x hover power efficiency
Route: equatorial organic dunes to Selk crater over 3.3-year surface mission
entries.implications: First nuclear-powered rotorcraft planetary mission. Titan's prebiotic chemistry laboratory accessible via regional mobility rather than single-landing constraints.
entries.c9_relevance: Terrestrial validation of autonomous exploration systems under extreme-environment constraints.

entries.title: Physicists are closing in on the origin of matter via baryon number transport
key_findings: Baryon number resides in quark-gluon interactions, not solely in quarks
Ruthenium-zirconium collision data disentangled charge exchange from baryon-number transport
Connected gluonic structure provides dynamical tracer of baryon number conservation
One of RHIC's final major results before shutdown
entries.implications: Essential for understanding primordial matter-antimatter asymmetry. Clarifies how baryon number is encoded and transported at fundamental level.
entries.c9_relevance: Fundamental constraint on Cluster 1 (quantum foundations) and Cluster 7 (quantum thermodynamics/entropy production in early universe).

entries.title: Astronomers discover a black hole 'star' (MoM-BH*-1) at cosmic dawn
key_findings: Object at z~8.5 (660 Myr post-Big Bang) shows strongest Balmer break ever measured
Spectrum dominated by H/He with no metal signatures; brightness exceeds nuclear fusion limits
Model: 100,000-10M solar mass BH surrounded by dense gas envelope 10-100 AU across
Dense hydrogen cocoon produces red color without dust; may explain 'little red dots'
entries.implications: Potential seeds of supermassive black holes. Suggests super-Eddington accretion in dust-free envelopes as early BH growth channel.
entries.c9_relevance: Links to QPLS and early-universe structure formation (Cluster 2). Possible A_c anomaly: hybrid star-BH object represents high-complexity transitional state.

entries.title: Magnonic spontaneous oscillation induced by parametric pumping
key_findings: Free-running magnons generated in YIG waveguide via four-wave mixing above Suhl instability threshold
Linewidth 23.5 kHz at 5.766 GHz (Q-factor ~245,000) at 0.11 T
Spontaneous mode phase-locks to external probe signal
Magnonic parametric amplifier gains up to 40 dB with 5% pump conversion efficiency
entries.implications: Pathway to synchronization-based information processing, low-power microwave tech, and hybrid superconducting-magnonic quantum circuits.
entries.c9_relevance: Cluster 6 (neuromorphic/magnonic computing) and Cluster 3 (quantum information). Room-temperature coherent control bridges classical and quantum regimes.

entries.title: Remnants of Theia discovered as large low-velocity provinces deep in Earth's mantle
key_findings: LLVPs beneath Africa and Pacific may contain iron-rich Theia mantle material from Moon-forming impact
Impact simulations show lower mantle remained solid and cool, preventing complete mixing
Theia material (2-3.5% denser than bulk silicate Earth) sinks and forms thermochemical piles over 4.5 Gyr
Noble gas isotope similarities between ocean-island basalts and lunar mare basalts support hypothesis
entries.implications: Giant impacts may not erase chemical differences in young planets. Implications for onset of plate tectonics, continent formation, and planetary evolution models.
entries.c9_relevance: Planetary-scale Assembly Index implication: ancient impactor material preserved as distinct thermochemical structures against entropy-driven mixing.

entries.title: No cosmological constraints on dark photon dark matter from resonant conversion
key_findings: Nonlinear plasma dynamics shut off dark photon -> SM photon conversion before significant heating
Opens ~10 orders of magnitude in dark photon mass parameter space (10^-15 to 10^-6 eV)
Invalidates 15-year-old linear cosmological exclusion bounds
Cross-disciplinary: plasma physics + particle physics + early-universe cosmology
entries.implications: Vast new experimental search space for dark photon dark matter. Requires rethinking of linear approximations in astrophysical environments (neutron stars, white dwarfs).
entries.c9_relevance: Cluster 1 (foundational assumptions in physics) and Cluster 2 (cosmology). Demonstrates how nonlinear dynamics restore theoretical degrees of freedom.

entries.title: Andromeda's star formation has declined sharply over past 500 million years
key_findings: PHAT+PHAST surveys of ~200M individual stars reveal declining star formation rate
SFR dropped from ~1 solar mass/yr (500 Mya) to ~0.2 solar masses/yr today
Slowdown concentrated on side nearest satellite galaxy M32 (~60 Mya onset)
Ring structure at 32,000 light-years shows diminished recent activity
entries.implications: Galaxy interactions can suppress star formation locally. Andromeda as Milky Way proxy suggests spiral galaxies experience episodic rather than steady-state stellar nurseries.
entries.c9_relevance: Cluster 4 (complexity/self-organization in galactic systems). Environmental modulation of stellar birth rates parallels other domain-specific suppression phenomena.

entries.title: Bound states in the continuum of gravitational waves
key_findings: Symmetry-protected BICs proposed for gravitational waves in flat spacetime
Periodic metric perturbations with odd parity can cancel propagating GW modes (even parity)
Solutions conserve energy/momentum locally despite distributional sources
Quasi-BICs could enhance inspiraling binary signals pre-merger or generate high-frequency GWs
entries.implications: Theoretical bridge between nanophotonics and gravitational physics. Potential applications in GW detection enhancement and graviton-photon conversion studies.
entries.c9_relevance: Cluster 5 (topological/non-Hermitian physics extended to spacetime metric). Speculative but mathematically rigorous; quasi-BICs offer testable predictions.

entries.title: Planet formation at cosmic dawn: planetesimals in H2O-rich disks around low-mass stars
key_findings: Rocky planet precursors formed 100 Myr after Big Bang around low-mass long-lived stars
Pair-instability Pop III supernovae enriched nearby gas with >100 solar masses of heavy elements
Simulated disk around 0.7 solar mass star contained several Earth masses of solids at 1 AU equivalent
Water content only few times less than solar system formation epoch
entries.implications: Habitable worlds could have appeared far earlier than previously assumed. Reframes chronology of life-capable environments in cosmic history.
entries.c9_relevance: Cluster 2 (cosmological assembly) and Cluster 4 (complexity emergence). Early planetary systems represent high-A_c structures emerging from Pop III nucleosynthetic feedback.

entries.title: Initial demonstration of a quantum heat engine based on dissipation-engineered superconducting circuits
key_findings: First cyclic quantum heat engine in superconducting circuits (Otto cycle)
Transmon qubit + resonator + quantum refrigerator operating near absolute zero
Same quantum refrigerator provides both hot and cold environments via timed control pulses
Positive work extracted from quantum-scale heat repeatedly and cyclically
entries.implications: Autonomous on-chip heat engines could eliminate millions of microwave cables in large-scale quantum computers (critical for 1000+ logical qubit systems by 2035).
entries.c9_relevance: Cluster 7 (quantum thermodynamics) and Cluster 6 (neuromorphic/quantum hardware). Directly addresses scalability constraints in quantum computing infrastructure.

entries.title: Twenty-year blazar monitoring of PKS 2155-304 reveals hadronic neutrino signatures
entries.institution: Institute of Nuclear Physics PAS / University of Heidelberg
key_findings: Swift+Fermi 2005-2024 data show single-electron-population models fail on long timescales
X-ray/optical correlation absent; X-ray flare hardness varies event-to-event
Statistically significant spectral kink at ~4.9 keV during non-flaring state (April 2012)
Hadronic origin likely; supports blazar jets as high-energy neutrino sources
entries.implications: Blazar variability requires multi-zone/multi-population models. Quiet-state hadronic emission may be key neutrino production channel, not just flares.
entries.c9_relevance: Cluster 2 (high-energy astrophysics) and Cluster 3 (information encoding in multimessenger signals). Multi-timescale dynamics mirror other C9 complex systems.

entries.title: Two independent studies push semiconductor qubits towards practical scales
key_findings: Delft: spin-shuttling architecture moves single qubit 1.2 microns to interact with 4 neighbors; 5-qubit entanglement demonstrated
HRL: 54-quantum-dot chip with custom cryogenic control IC and superconducting ribbon cable
Error-detection/correction routines improve performance ~10x over previous silicon qubits
Tackles connectivity and control bottlenecks simultaneously
entries.implications: Silicon spin qubits compatible with CMOS manufacturing now have viable paths to modular, scalable quantum processors.
entries.c9_relevance: Cluster 6 (neuromorphic/SNN hardware) and Cluster 3 (quantum information). Critical hardware milestone for practical quantum advantage.

entries.title: Venus may have hidden vast oceans for billions of years
key_findings: Ancient tesserae terrain morphology resembles continents shaped by water-rock interaction
Up to 90% of Venus may have been ocean-covered before runaway greenhouse
Planet possibly remained temperate for hundreds of millions to billions of years
VERITAS and EnVision missions will test interpretations with high-resolution radar
entries.implications: Expands habitable window for early Venus. Raises possibility of microbial life before climate collapse. Critical exoplanet analogy: near-identical planets can diverge catastrophically.
entries.c9_relevance: Cluster 8 (habitability/consciousness studies) and Cluster 4 (complex adaptive systems). Venus as failed-state analogue for planetary climate stability.

entries.title: Initial mass function varies with star-forming environment
key_findings: Gaia data on Milky Way star clusters show environment-dependent stellar mass distributions
Universal IMF assumption oversimplifies galaxy mass measurements
Cluster-to-cluster differences are 'surprisingly clean' and systematic
May partially explain JWST early-galaxy mass discrepancies
entries.implications: Distant galaxy mass estimates, stellar population ages, and cosmological simulations may need recalibration with environment-dependent IMFs.
entries.c9_relevance: Cluster 4 (complexity science): demonstrates that macroscopic scaling laws (IMF) emerge from local environmental conditions, not universal constants.

entries.title: Chemical fingerprints of binary mass transfer in massive stars
entries.institution: Max Planck Institute for Astrophysics / University of Bonn
key_findings: Comprehensive MESA grid reveals mass gainers occupy distinct branch in CNO abundance diagram
Analytic framework constrains accreted mass, donor mass, and mass-transfer efficiency from surface abundances alone
Gamma Columbae identified as mass gainer (not stripped star); donor was >15 solar masses
Method applied to SN 1987A rings confirms merger origin with diluted CNO-equilibrium abundances
entries.implications: Surface spectroscopy can reconstruct binary evolution histories for apparently single stars. Sharpens gravitational-wave progenitor predictions (LIGO sources).
entries.c9_relevance: Cluster 2 (gravitational-wave source progenitors) and Cluster 4 (population dynamics). Turns observational chemistry into historical reconstruction tool.

entries.title: IBM quantum computing models tritium behavior in fusion reactor blankets
entries.institution: IBM / Oak Ridge National Laboratory / Cleveland Clinic
key_findings: First known fusion-material computation on quantum hardware
Nine molecular configurations of FLiBe molten salt modeled with quantum-classical hybrid
Calculates tritium binding strength to salt for fuel recovery assessment
Complements May 2026 protein-drug interaction modeling on IBM quantum systems
entries.implications: Quantum simulation approaching industrially relevant chemistry. Tritium breeding/recovery is critical path for commercial fusion power.
entries.c9_relevance: Cluster 6 (practical quantum computing) and Cluster 7 (thermodynamics of energy systems). Bridges C9 quantum interests with terrestrial energy infrastructure.

entries.title: Full sound rainbows created and imaged for the first time
entries.institution: Two independent research teams (New Scientist report)
key_findings: Elastic rainbows previously limited to tiny edge/corner regions of materials
New devices separate sound waves by frequency across full spatial field
Two independent teams achieved complete sound rainbows simultaneously
Potential for sound-based information processing and energy harvesting
entries.implications: Extends rainbow phenomenon from optics to acoustics/phononics. Could enable novel signal processing architectures using elastic waves.
entries.c9_relevance: Cluster 5 (topological wave phenomena) and Cluster 6 (information processing). Analogous to photonic BICs and magnon control in same collection.

entries.title: Physicists extend Hawking's black hole laws to dynamical objects
key_findings: Dynamical horizon segments replace teleological event horizons for thermodynamic analysis
First and second laws apply to far-from-equilibrium black holes (forming, merging, evaporating)
Intensive parameters (pressure/temperature analogues) defined for instantaneous non-equilibrium states
Event horizons 'entirely absent' when quantum effects included; supports Hawking's late view
entries.implications: Resolves 1990s 'elephant in the room' about black hole entropy definition. Removes information-loss paradox confusion. Extended beyond general relativity to loop quantum gravity.
entries.c9_relevance: Cluster 1 (quantum foundations) and Cluster 7 (quantum thermodynamics). Foundational advance linking classical thermodynamics, GR, and quantum gravity.
